text: So recently I chose to cut some people out my circle Pops told me figures what you're doing, what you get Hang with five broke niggas and you're bound to be the sixth This is it, this is life, I'ma quit, rip the mics Full of passion, stay in ends and take the triggers out my life I chill with people after all these years But really all we got in common dawg is all these years What I'm wanting and pursuing ain't reflecting what you're doing Cause your life is at a standstill, damn it you my man still But still I keep you at a healthy distance Cause if I gotta carry your shit in minds I can't go to this place
